skinTears.note: One number now rather than two. The skin proper -- trunk, neck, tail, all four limbs -- peaks at 2.34x in Sprint, exactly as it did with the one-sac lining, because nothing about the skinning changed. The lining used to be the body's worst deformer at 6.57x and that was its wall doing what a stretching wall does; a palate rigid on the skull and a floor rigid on the jaw stretch nothing, so the figure including the oral parts is the skin figure. Nine clips tore an edge past 2x before; two do now, and both are the paddle row.

gapeSolid.note: Measured on the committed sac body and on this build at the same five shots and the same backdrop test. Nothing is seen through the body in either; the palate/floor pair opens fewer silhouette pixels than the sac did (55-62 against 76-84), which is the shells' rear caps filling the corner of the mouth the sac's wall used to stand across. The 11 px the README quoted for the sac was measured at the older, looser backdrop window and went to 0 when the window was measured against the backdrop itself (CLAUDE.md). The three leaks the note below describes were closed on the sac and stayed closed on the shells: the floor runs to the front cap on the jaw, the two shells are sized on the measured room (0.84 of it), and the commissure is covered by the palate's rear rings.
